findings.text: The BT185 test only exercises the exported helper updateExistingJobsBatched; nothing proves runStuttgartShootoutAndIngest actually routes toUpdate through it (the BT164 test change only adds .limit to a mock), so a regression to the per-row .update().eq() loop would pass.

'Matches live migration catalog' is not proven: no test compares migration_bt185_composite_indexes.sql with schema.sql, and live-index-snapshot-2026-09-22.json (a pin of a live read) was edited to add idx_jobs_status_last_checked, so the BT172 parity check is self-confirming rather than compared to live; the companies index is only checked by the new toContain assertion, not by any snapshot.

The reconcileCompanyJobDelta chunk test covers only the missing-scan increment path (6 missing jobs, chunkSize 2); the relink (refreshedCandidate) and restore (consecutive_missing_scans reset) task branches, and the new error-gated counting of missingArchived/missingIncremented/restoredCount, are untested.
